English:
This folder contains the structural drawings and 3D models for the End Effector Adapter Plates. These components are designed to connect the robot arm with various dexterous hands. Please refer to the PDF files for 2D dimensions and the STEP files for 3D assembly verification.
中文：
本文件夹包含末端转接板的结构图纸和3D模型。这些组件用于连接机械臂与不同型号的灵巧手。您可以查看 PDF 文件获取二维尺寸信息，或使用 STEP 文件进行三维装配验证。
